# Mastering Zotero

> A comprehensive user guide for Zotero, the open-source reference manager for collecting, organizing, and citing scholarly sources.

This manual provides step-by-step tutorials for both new and experienced Zotero users across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms. It covers core workflows including item collection, file management, organization through tags and collections, and citation generation with support for Citation Style Language (CSL) standards.

## Key Topics

- Zotero reference manager
- Citation management
- Bibliography generation
- Web translators
- Collections and tags
- Citation Style Language (CSL)
- Word processor plugins
- Sync and collaboration
- DOI and identifiers
- Cross-platform support
- Getting started
- Scholarly research
- File attachments
- Group libraries

## Getting Started

- [Mastering Zotero](https://zotero-manual.github.io): Homepage for Mastering Zotero reference manager user guide
- [Introduction](https://zotero-manual.github.io/introduction): Introduction to Zotero features including sync and group collaboration
- [Installing Zotero](https://zotero-manual.github.io/installing-zotero): Installation guide for Zotero Standalone and browser connectors

## Core Workflows

- [Adding Items](https://zotero-manual.github.io/adding-items): Tutorial on adding items via translators, manual entry, and identifiers
- [Adding Files](https://zotero-manual.github.io/adding-files): Guide to file attachment management and storage syncing in Zotero
- [Citations](https://zotero-manual.github.io/citations): Tutorial on citation styles, bibliography generation, and word processor plugins

## Library Organization

- [Collections](https://zotero-manual.github.io/collections): Guide to creating and managing collections and subcollections
- [Tags](https://zotero-manual.github.io/tags): Tutorial on tag management and library organization in Zotero

## About

- [Preface](https://zotero-manual.github.io/preface): Preface and author information for Mastering Zotero manual
